counting: This is a measured software/experiment profile, not an automatic verdict about intelligence. Codes, content classes, relations, names and NSM entries have different denominators.

measured.domain: N131;65 correspondences, two directional content classes
measured.use: 195/195 physical reads in three rounds; old32 retained after new33 in longitudinal arm

measured.mechanism: Relative A/B history, phase-controlled access, later physical form NORD

measured.limit: Bipolar operational order relation; fixed referent interfaces, not unrestricted BEFORE/AFTER semantics

measured.mechanism: Physical contextual encounter changes route and later accessibility; alternative declared access probes retained relation
measured.domain: N67, +/-z context and tested fixed readers
measured.limit: Alternative access is requested externally, not autonomous repair or consequence-learned policy

measured.mechanism: Learned directional mobile relations plus geometrically ordered encounters
measured.domain: N67, AB/BA prepared routes, new-load reserves
measured.limit: Order of operations supplied by preparation; equal scalar39 has different vectors, not inference of any temporal order

measured.mechanism: Request travels to acquired sender relation, returns via native relays, combines with old contextual relation; later N0 exposure
measured.limit: User-induced request and prepared routes; symmetric bank contact, not adaptive optimization

measured.mechanism: One Runtime,1..4 prepared distributed role sets; private histories, native request-return/context contacts

measured.limit: Resources increase with population; no demonstrated policy update between all regions labelled as one actor or decision needing all four

measured.limit: No free conversation; renderer does not supply missing native content
